A simulated policy panel for the examples

Source: R/policy_evaluation.R
polex.Rd

Twenty districts in four regions over 36 months; a reform adopted region by region in three stages (months 13, 19 and 25), with the fourth region never adopting it; crime and arrest rates and counts. The numbers are made up, with a known effect of the reform (a fall of 3 in the crime rate per 100,000), so the examples and tests can check that each estimator recovers it.

Usage

polex(seed = 20240101)

Arguments

seed

The seed (default 20240101).

Value

A data frame: district, region, month, refmonth (NA for never), reformed (0 or 1), population, logpop, crimes, crmrate, arrrate.

Examples

head(polex())
#>   district region month refmonth reformed population   logpop crimes crmrate
#> 1      D01     R1     1       13        0     152152 11.93264     80  39.732
#> 2      D01     R1     2       13        0     152152 11.93264     56  42.708
#> 3      D01     R1     3       13        0     152152 11.93264     68  41.228
#> 4      D01     R1     4       13        0     152152 11.93264     68  43.296
#> 5      D01     R1     5       13        0     152152 11.93264     62  42.036
#> 6      D01     R1     6       13        0     152152 11.93264     59  40.197
#>   arrrate
#> 1  15.394
#> 2  16.387
#> 3  16.043
#> 4  17.148
#> 5  15.443
#> 6  15.568
